svg.title: SILO community — 54 contributors
svg.desc: The existing SILO community roll, including code, proposals and reports across related projects. Gold rings retain the existing significant-contribution designation. Snapshot 2026-09-23.
svg.text: Code, proposals & reports across SILO and related projects
